title: Dependency-aware regional cutover priming and Terraform automation for Private VPCs
creator: Aisha R. Patel
description: Build an automation flow and Terraform modules that perform dependency-aware regional cutovers for Private (VPC) deployments. The goal is a reproducible, safe cutover drill that performs preflight checks, primes KV caches and read-replicas, stages DNS/TTL and load balancer weights, and validates application-level consistency before shifting production traffic. This ticket focuses on the automations and preflight gates; separate tickets will cover full runbook authoring and operator UI. Key constraints: non-disruptive to active region, idempotent steps, clear rollback points, and integration with existing private Terraform modules and the Console's rollout API.
acceptance_criteria: A terraform module (module.cutover_priming) can be invoked to run preflight validators across regions without altering live traffic
Automated priming flow performs KV cache warm-up by replaying sanitized request prefixes to target region caches and logs success/failure per sharded cache
Storage replication lag gate: cutover is blocked if object-store or DB replication lag exceeds configured thresholds
DNS/ALB staging: automation supports staged TTL reduction and traffic weight ramping (0->5%->25%->100%) with automatic rollback on health degradation
A health-gate step aggregates metrics (p50 latency, error rate, model-quality regression score) and prevents promotion if any metric crosses configured SLO thresholds
All actions are reversible; automation emits a deterministic rollback plan and a Terraform output with run metadata and links to logs
Integration tests simulate a two-region cluster and validate that priming + gating prevents a cutover when a synthetic data-consistency error is injected
tasks: Design dependency graph for services used during cutover (kv cache shards, model serving, storage replicas, auth)
Extend private Terraform modules to expose cutover hooks and priming job definitions
Implement priming worker (Go) that reads sanitized prefix traces from S3 and warms KV caches with idempotency keys
Add replication lag probes for DB and object storage (postgres replica lag, S3 replication status)
Create gating Lambda that evaluates metrics from Console telemetry and Canary probes
Wire Terraform workflow to invoke gating and stage DNS weights via DNS provider API
Build CI integration test using localstack/k3s that runs full priming and validates rollback behavior
Document runbook summary and create operator quick-check dashboard in Console

notes: This ticket intentionally avoids user-visible rollout UI changes. The priming worker will be a short-lived job run by Terraform via the new module hook. We will coordinate with Console team to later expose the gating results and allow manual overrides with audit logs. Risk areas: accidentally promoting stale replicas, cache storms during warm-up, and missing RBAC for KMS/replication status APIs. Plan to run two drills in staging and one dry-run in a small production tenant before broad rollout.
